messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- The Ember team decided that the job scheduler will use leader election instead of a single fixed node. [decision; valid 2025-06-06 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-06-06]
- The job scheduler's single fixed node turned every restart into a missed run. [valid 2025-06-06 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-06-06]
- The job scheduler leader lease will be shortened to ten seconds, a decision from the INC-2026-009 review. [decision; valid 2026-05-19 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-009]
- As of 2026-03-09, feature-flags is owned by the Atlas team; the 2026-02-11 handover note that said team Dune was written against the wrong team, and Dune never owned it. [decision; valid 2026-03-09 to now; recorded by handover/2026-03-09-feature-flags-correction]
- Certificate expiry will alert 30 days ahead, a follow-up decision from the INC-2025-017 review. [decision; valid 2025-08-07 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-017]
- INC-2026-009 was an incident in which the job scheduler ran the nightly jobs twice on 2026-05-16. [valid 2026-05-19 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-009]
- The root cause of INC-2025-023 was a reindex job that failed silently on a full disk. [valid 2025-10-07 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-023]
- The root cause of INC-2026-003 was a retry loop that ignored idempotency keys. [valid 2026-02-26 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-003]
- As of 2026-01-30, the Cinder team agreed that auth gateway tokens will expire after 15 minutes instead of an hour, because the security audit flagged long-lived tokens. [decision; valid 2026-01-30 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2026-01-30]
- On 2026-06-04, the Boreal team noticed that the catalog service's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-06-04 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-06-04]
- As of 2025-09-23, the Cinder team owns the job scheduler; team Dune owned it until then. [valid 2025-09-23 to now; recorded by handover/2025-09-23-scheduler]
    earlier: As of 2025-09-05, team Dune still owns the job scheduler. [valid 2025-09-05 to 2025-09-23; recorded by standup/dune/2025-09-05]
- As of 2025-09-23, the Cinder team owns the job scheduler, which team Dune owned until then. [valid 2025-09-23 to now; recorded by handover/2025-09-23-scheduler]
- Team Dune observed that the notification service's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change. [valid 2025-03-26 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-03-26]
- The root cause of INC-2025-004 was a notifier consumer offset stuck after a broker restart. [valid 2025-02-05 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-004]
- The Cinder team observed that the webhook dispatcher's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change. [valid 2025-05-14 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-05-14]
- As of 2026-04-14, Farah holds the Dune on-call shift for team Dune, taking over from Tomasz; Tomasz held it as of 2026-03-11, and Farah held it as of 2026-01-16. [decision; valid 2026-04-14 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-04-14]
    earlier: As of 2026-03-11, Tomasz holds the Dune on-call shift for team Dune, taking over from Farah; as of 2026-01-16 Farah held it. [decision; valid 2026-03-11 to 2026-04-14; recorded by standup/dune/2026-03-11]
    earlier: As of 2026-01-16, Farah Haddad holds the Dune on-call shift for team Dune; Tomasz is off rotation. [decision; valid 2026-01-16 to 2026-03-11; recorded by standup/dune/2026-01-16]
    earlier: As of 2025-12-10, Tomasz holds the Dune on-call shift for team Dune, having taken over from Farah. [valid 2025-12-10 to 2026-01-16; recorded by standup/dune/2025-12-10]
    earlier: As of 2025-11-17, Farah still holds the Dune on-call shift for team Dune, having taken over from Tomasz. [valid 2025-11-17 to 2025-12-10; recorded by standup/dune/2025-11-17]
    earlier: As of 2025-10-15, Farah holds the Dune on-call shift for team Dune, having taken over from Tomasz. [valid 2025-10-15 to 2025-11-17; recorded by standup/dune/2025-10-15]
    earlier: As of 2025-09-04, Tomasz holds the Dune on-call shift, having picked it up from Farah. [valid 2025-09-04 to 2025-10-15; recorded by standup/dune/2025-09-04]
- As of 2025-12-18, the indexer will rebuild the index nightly instead of on every catalog write, because incremental updates left stale entries behind after failed writes. [decision; valid 2025-12-18 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-12-18]
- The indexer is pinned to OpenSearch 2.11, and the pin lifts when the full reindex completes. [constraint; valid 2025-04-22 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-04-22]
